title: Secrets to a Successful Marriage
description: Marriage the Islamic way: the secrets of a successful marriage from the teachings of the Salaf. From preparing properly and choosing a spouse, to the rights of each side, keeping trust, and solving the inevitable conflicts. The complete marriage series from AMAU Academy (Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan and Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble) with lectures from Ulul Absaar Project.
short_description: The secrets to a successful Islamic marriage
